reading: The sketch is a hero banner: two stacked giant "SUMMER" headings bleeding off the page edges, two tilted overlapping color/gradient blocks layered in front of the headings (one peach/brown gradient with a hard offset shadow, one ink-like multiply-blend grey-to-blue gradient), three tilted pill badges reading "New season", "Linen only" and "Ships in 24h", a small "ORRA" wordmark top-left, a body paragraph of placeholder text, and a bold underlined "Shop summer →" link below. A run-level note sets the overall page style: off-white background, Helvetica type, dark brown text, fine grain texture overlay.
